data.exact_reserve_text: There was a deterioration during the year of GBP 6.6 million (2017: GBP 1.2 million) in gross incurred claims, on reserves held at 31 December 2017. The majority of this relates to the Property class of business.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross strengthening of GBP 6.6 million in prior year reserves for 2018, primarily impacting the Property class of business. This represents an 8.34% strengthening relative to the opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 79.102 million. The claims development triangle for 2016 and older years shows a strengthening of GBP 1.552 million for the 2016 underwriting year.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration during the year of GBP 6.6 million
gross incurred claims, on reserves held at 31 December 2017
majority of this relates to the Property class of business

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage of Property

data.data_quality_notes: The narrative prior year development figure of GBP 6.6m is stated to be "on reserves held at 31 December 2017", which implies it includes movements on the 2017 underwriting year. However, the claims development triangle calculation for "prior year development" (excluding the two most recent years) only covers 2016 and older, yielding a different figure of GBP 1.552m for 2016. The narrative figure is used as it is explicitly stated as the overall prior year movement. The attribution of the full GBP 6.6m to Property is based on the narrative stating "the majority of this relates to the Property class of business".
